g.text: B Fixed 25 dimensions: unused neighborhood blocks permuted
CellCharter | DLPFC 151507 | Two exploratory hop ablations
Identical metric definitions and labeled-spot/edge sets; not a matched-initialization causal comparison
n = 1 explored section, 1 seed per condition; 4,221 labeled spots, 12,381 evaluated edges, 950 reference-boundary edges.
Group B h=0 contains shuffled neighborhood blocks (not expression-only). GMM h=4 fits differ across experiments (partition ARI = 0.713871).
Higher boundary recall may reflect many false-positive edges; none of these curves alone establishes spatial over-smoothing.
